name: run-phptests
description: Run pull request test suite for a PHP project.

github-token.description: GitHub token for reviewdog reporting. Reporting is skipped when empty.

working-directory.description: Directory to run the test suite in, relative to the workspace. Defaults to the workspace root.

install.description: Install Composer dependencies when `vendor/autoload.php` is missing [auto,true,false]. `auto` installs when a composer.json is present.

runner.description: Test runner to use [auto,pest,phpunit,composer]. `auto` picks pest, then phpunit, then the composer `test` script.

paths.description: Optional paths or filters to pass to the test runner. Defaults to the whole suite.

flags.description: Additional flags to pass to the test runner.

coverage.description: Generate a clover coverage report [auto,true,false]. `auto` skips coverage when no xdebug/pcov driver is loaded.

coverage-file.description: Clover coverage report to write when coverage is enabled.

junit-file.description: JUnit report to write, used to report failing tests with reviewdog.

migrate.description: Run `artisan migrate` before the suite [auto,true,false]. `auto` migrates when the project has migrations.

name.description: Name reported by reviewdog to identify this check.

reporter.description: Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-check,github-pr-review]. Defaults to the reporter resolved by setup-reviewdog for this run's context (github-pr-check on pull requests, github-check otherwise).

fail-level.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error].

coverage-file.description: Path of the generated coverage report, empty when no report was produced.

junit-file.description: Path of the generated JUnit report, empty when no report was produced.
